Selected caller-provided stable IDs, closed private DRAFT input and deterministic bytes; no ID allocation supported now.

Trusted existing private configured input/intake/draft roots are disjoint. Validate full supported revisions/paths/descriptors/counts/bytes with no silent coercion. Copy through protected native handles/closed snapshot, reject reparse/hardlink/TOCTOU outside selected roots; hash exact copied bytes and reread inventory. No arbitrary caller canonical destination, network or mutable source reopening after publication. Source and intake disjoint existing roots; source draft supplies persistence. Pure document/schema/descriptor validation only; refs/CAS against accepted Bank belong to app, publication is not acceptance.

Create unique transaction directory exclusively; preserve transaction/object/revision IDs and exact manifest/payload bytes for retries. Never replace an existing published or conflicting package or automatically issue new retry IDs. Define explicit inspect/resume policy for incomplete owned drafts; unknown/different existing contents remain visible and unchanged. Explicit resume only for fully verified matching pending generation; no repair/rewrite of partial missing payload. Inspect works without source; both previous published and incomplete bytes preserved on mismatches.

Payloads closed/verified before manifest; write and flush READY.pending, publish READY.json last with actual same-volume atomic no-overwrite native primitive. Partial/cancelled/dead process cannot publish complete marker; reader sees incomplete or complete valid package. Do not infer hardware power-loss durability from rename/process tests. Own target directory share-read/write lease retains no-delete confinement; first blocked primitive probe and corrected actual native collision proof preserved. Tests must reject directory rename/redirect while lease held.

pre_execution_questions.question: Which no-overwrite atomic Windows publication primitive meets the existing contract?
